query: In 1991 Euromarché was bought by a chain that operated how any hypermarkets at the end of 2016?

repl_history.response:
According to the Global Context Preview:

"Carrefour S.A. ( ) is a French multinational retailer headquartered in Boulogne Billancourt, France, in the Hauts-de-Seine Department near Paris.  It is one of the largest hypermarket chains in the world (with 1,462 hypermarkets at the end of 2016)."

This snippet clearly states that Carrefour operated 1,462 hypermarkets at the end of 2016.

FINAL ANSWER: 1462
